# Propel-Lab

> Propel-Lab LLC is an AI/LLM technology company based in Fukuoka, Japan, engineering next-generation business models through systems thinking and AI.

## Company Info
- Legal Name: Propel-Lab LLC (合同会社 Propel-Lab)
- Location: Fukuoka, Japan (Tenjin 4-6-28, Tenjin First Bldg. 7F)
- Founder & CEO: Ken Imoto (井本 賢)
- Founded: April 24, 2025
- Email: info@propel-lab.co.jp
- URL: https://propel-lab.co.jp/

## Mission
Engineer the next generation of business models through systems thinking and technology.

## Professional Services (Work With Us)
Productized services with fixed scope and upfront pricing — no sales meetings. Overview: https://propel-lab.co.jp/services/
- Tier 0: llmo-checker (OSS, free) — LLMO Score self-check CLI: https://github.com/open-llmo/llmo-checker
- Tier 1: LLMO Audit Report (¥98,000, 1 domain, 2-week delivery) — structural audit + measured AI-citation rates across Perplexity/Claude/Gemini/ChatGPT + prioritized P0/P1/P2 roadmap: https://propel-lab.co.jp/llmo-audit/
- Tier 2: Implementation Support (¥300,000/month) — monthly re-audit + implementation help, available to audit customers only
- Sample report (PDF, 16 pages, all figures measured): https://propel-lab.co.jp/files/llmo-audit-sample-legacydram.pdf
- Pilot tracking (legacydram.com leading indicators, public time-series): https://propel-lab.co.jp/llmo-audit-pilot/

## Services
1. LLMO Audit & Implementation Support — LLM optimization consulting: measured AI-citation diagnostics across Perplexity/Claude/Gemini/ChatGPT with prioritized P0/P1/P2 roadmaps (fixed scope, no sales meetings; see "Professional Services" above)
2. LearningMate — Educational content and publishing focused on LLM technologies (Claude Code, Context Engineering, LLMO)
3. AI-Loop — SNS automation and content marketing support powered by LLM agents
4. AutoCrew — Business automation consulting using multi-agent LLM systems (MCP, CLI Skills)
5. KaoriQ — AI-driven autonomous e-commerce operations (kaoriq.com fragrance platform with personality-based recommendations)
6. mypcrig — AI-driven autonomous content media (mypcrig.com PC-selection guides with GA4 + Search Console feedback loop)
7. legacydram — AI-driven autonomous curation media (legacydram.com whisky curation read through an engineer's lens)
8. Yureru — Music and creative project featuring virtual singers Yumei and Silk Reign
